prompt: Can you review PriceStreamRepository.kt before I merge it? It works in my own testing but a teammate said the streaming felt off and prices sometimes freeze on the watchlist. Anything you'd flag?
assertions: Flags that `runCatching` wraps a suspend call and therefore swallows CancellationException
Flags the empty `catch (e: Exception) {}` in stream() that swallows everything including cancellation
Flags constructing `Json {}` per call instead of reusing one instance
Flags returning the cached value / 0.0 on failure as masking the outage (a fake price = fake success), and calls out the 0.0 sentinel as dangerous in a trading app
Flags the hardcoded `Dispatchers.IO` as hurting testability (should be injected)
Flags `accumulated += chunk` + re-`split("\n")` as O(n^2) and/or re-emitting old/duplicate lines — i.e. connects it to the 'streaming felt off' / freeze symptom
Flags the bare `while (true)` loop with no delay/backoff (request storm / dispatcher starvation)
Frames the review at Tier 0 (app data code) and does NOT demand explicitApi/ABI/publishing rules
